page.layout: One text column. Two marginal notes in the left margin, beside the lines "Materiae conciliatoriarum epistolarum" and "Imitatio conciliatoriae epistolae". Running head at the top. Page number at the head. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Pars quarta & postrema conclusio confirmabit, vel δέησις petitione, vt flagranti nostro amori ignoscere, commendatosque sibi nos habere amicus dignetur. lib. 15. epist. 10. Vel ἀναμνήσει[?] pollicitatione memoriae, fidei, obseruantiae, gratitudinis perpetuae. Materiae conciliatoriarum epistolarum.lib. 5. epist. 4. 7. libr. 6. epist. 16. Sunt autem, quae in Ciceronis reperiuntur epistolis familiaribus, amoris ac beneuolentiae conciliationes. lib. 5. epist. 4. 9. lib. 6. epistol. 16. libro decimoquinto, epistol. 10. Nos ad imitandum, 9. libr. 5. nobis proponemus, in qua Ciceroni sefe de nota, quod aiunt, meliori Vatinius commedat. Partes illius Epistolae sunt: Principium, in quo causas Vatinius recenset, quibus adductus Ciceronis sibi conciliare beneuolentiam conetur. Propositio, in qua Ciceronem idem rogat, vt sefe comendatum sibi habere velit. Confirmatio, petitionis causas & rationes continens. Conclusio quae gratitudinis pollicitatione absoluitur. Hac ergo secuti epistolā à docto aliquo claroq; viro petemus, vt in suorū nos amicorū aut clientum numero habeat. Sētētiae tales esse poterūt.
I. Si pristinam adhuc consuetudinem in amandis atque promouendis bonarum artium studiosis fer-[?]: nunc ad te venio: & vt tuo dignum me amore

page.notes: Marginal note "Imitatio conciliatoriae epistolae." (left margin, beside "libro decimoquinto") was not written as a note element, since the printed note is partly lost: the scan shows "Imitatio co- / ciliatoriae e- / pistolae." Its placement is at the lines "libro decimoquinto" to "imitandum". The Greek words are uncertain: "δέησις" is a likely reading, and "ἀναμνήσει" is a guess from the shape of the letters. The word after "fer-" at the end of the italic line is hard to read. The catchword "ac pa-" is the first word of the next page.
